name: minecraft-mystery-dashboard
description: 单机一体的 Minecraft 服务端 Web 管理面板

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mmd/shared && npm run build -w @mmd/server && npm run build -w @mmd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mmd/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mmd/server && npm run typecheck -w @mmd/web
scripts.verify: npm run knowledge:check && npm run knowledge:test && npm run portable:test && npm run windows:test && npm run build -w @mmd/shared && npm run typecheck && npm run test:security -w @mmd/server && npm run build && npm run test:static
